name: Bieten
summary: Trick-taking bluffing game with German cards where players bid on who holds the best suit, pair or run.
rules_text: With 33 German-suited cards (36 minus 6 of Acorns, Leaves, Hearts, plus Weli) each player gets 3 or 4 cards. No trumps, must follow suit. Highest card of led suit wins trick. Before or after playing to a trick, on your turn you may bid one unbid Figure you hold: Red (highest Heart), Green (highest Leaf), Gleich (highest pair/triple by rank), Hanger (highest run of same suit), Spiel (win last trick). Opponents in order say good or hold. If all say good, bidder scores 1 (2 if he bid 'three'). If any holds, highest actual Figure scores 2 (3 if three was bid). Unbid Figures score 1 to holder. Weli gives 1 point. First to 11 points wins; you may not bid to exceed 11.
rating_reason: Bluffing card game, persuading opponent to fold despite poor hand.
